name: Out-of-core multimodal registration (KonfAI + IMPACT)
desc: Deformable registration of a pre-aligned pair of OME-Zarr volumes, in tiles when the volumes do not fit in GPU memory: FireANTs SyN, ConvexAdam or elastix B-spline, driven by intensity, MIND or IMPACT (TotalSegmentator) features. Writes the displacement field as OME-Zarr RFC-5 (and as an ITK .h5 transform for 3D Slicer) and the moving image resampled onto the fixed grid. KonfAI + impact-reg-konfai; presets from the APEX BRAIN CONNECTS and LINC hemisphere work.
desc_override: Out-of-core deformable registration of OME-Zarr volumes (FireANTs / ConvexAdam / elastix, IMPACT features)

inputs.desc: The fixed image: the grid the field and the moved image are written on. A scalar OME-Zarr volume (z, y, x; a size-1 c/t axis is squeezed).
The moving image, already affine-aligned to the fixed image (the presets hold the affine at identity).
Tissue mask on the fixed grid (0/1). Optional for a whole-volume run; needed for a tiled one, where a tile of background otherwise fits the background.
Tissue mask on the moving grid (0/1). Optional; see fixed_mask.

outputs.desc: The displacement field on the fixed grid, mm, as an OME-Zarr RFC-5 `displacements` coordinate transformation (data.ome.zarr) and as an ITK transform (Transform.h5, opens in 3D Slicer).
The moving image resampled through the field onto the fixed grid (not written when fields_only is set).

preset.desc: The registration preset (presets/<name> in the repository): the engine, the metric and its features, the resolution it was tuned for, and whether it tiles.

options.label: APEX_CONVEXADAM_MIND (ConvexAdam)
options.desc: ConvexAdam on the affine-aligned 0.4 mm pair: 3-D MIND R2D2 at 0.8 mm, L1, grid 2 feature voxels, grid shrink 2, no linear stage.

options.label: APEX_FA_RET_BSPLINE (elastix)
options.desc: Intensity-only elastix B-spline on a 0.4 mm grid after an affine: Mattes MI, bending energy 100, fixed tissue mask

options.label: APEX_FIREANTS_SYN_CC (FireANTs)
options.desc: FireANTs SyN on the affine-aligned 0.4 mm pair: local cross-correlation, affine held at identity, warp and gradient smoothing 1.0 and 1.5 voxels.

options.label: APEX_FIREANTS_TS (FireANTs)
options.desc: FireANTs SyN on the affine-aligned 0.4 mm pair, driven by IMPACT on TotalSegmentator features (the preset's own TS model), affine held at identity, smoothing 1.0 and 1.5 voxels.

options.label: LINC_BSPLINE_L0_TILED (elastix)
options.desc: elastix B-spline, Mattes MI + bending energy (weight 100): a window of level 0 (20 µm) in 256³ tiles: stage 4.

options.label: LINC_BSPLINE_L3_TILED (elastix)
options.desc: elastix B-spline, Mattes MI + bending energy (weight 100): level 3 (0.16 mm) in 256³ tiles: stage 3.

options.label: LINC_BSPLINE_L4 (elastix)
options.desc: elastix B-spline, Mattes MI + bending energy (weight 100): the whole hemisphere at level 4 (0.32 mm): stage 2 and the FLASH check.

options.label: LINC_BSPLINE_ZOOM1_TILED (elastix)
options.desc: elastix B-spline, Mattes MI + bending energy (weight 100): zoom 1 on the overview at level 1 (40 µm) in 256³ tiles: stage 5.

options.label: LINC_CONVEXADAM_L3_TILED (ConvexAdam)
options.desc: ConvexAdam on MIND features: level 3 (0.16 mm) in 192³ tiles, with APEX_CONVEXADAM_MIND's settings.

options.label: LINC_FIREANTS_L3_TILED (FireANTs)
options.desc: FireANTs SyN, cross-correlation: level 3 (0.16 mm) in 192³ tiles, with APEX_FIREANTS_SYN_CC's settings.

options.label: LINC_MIND (elastix)
options.desc: MIND (R1D2, L1) through the IMPACT metric, with mutual information and a bending penalty weighted by parameter_overrides

options.label: NATIVE_MIND (elastix)
options.desc: MIND R1D2 2-D through the IMPACT metric, in plane, with mutual information; weights and the z lock via parameter_overrides

options.label: OCT_LIGHTSHEET_MIND (elastix)
options.desc: 2-D MIND (R2D2) through the IMPACT metric, plus mutual information and a light bending penalty; the B-spline has no freedom in z

options.label: SECTION_BSPLINE_NATIVE_TILED (elastix)
options.desc: elastix B-spline, Mattes MI + bending energy (weight 100): the section's 3 µm window in [8, 512, 512] tiles: section stage 3.

options.label: SECTION_MIND (elastix)
options.desc: MIND R1D2 2-D through the IMPACT metric, in plane, with mutual information; weights and the z lock via parameter_overrides

options.label: SECTION_MIND3D (elastix)
options.desc: MIND R1D2 2-D through the IMPACT metric, in plane, with mutual information; weights and the z lock via parameter_overrides

device.desc: Where the preset runs. The GPU is the intended device (a 256³ elastix tile peaks near 16.5 GiB, a 192³ FireANTs tile near 18 GiB); the CPU is a fallback for small pairs.

patch_size.desc: Tile size in voxels (z y x, or one number for a cube). Empty: the preset's own setting (the whole volume for the APEX presets, tiles for the *_TILED ones). Tiles need both masks.

overlap.desc: Overlap between neighbouring tiles, as a percentage of the tile ('12%') or in voxels ('16'). Empty: the preset's own, or 12% when patch_size is set.

fields_only.desc: Write the displacement field only; skip resampling the moving image (saves the time and disk of a second volume; brainlife then reports the moved output as missing).

cpu_workers.desc: Threads for a CPU run (0: the cores the scheduler allotted).

extra_set.desc: Further `impact-reg-konfai register --set NAME=VALUE` overrides of the preset's Prediction.yml, ';'-separated (a bare NAME targets the model's parameters; a dotted path any existing key).

citation.impact: Boussot et al., IMPACT: a generic semantic loss for multimodal medical image registration, https://github.com/vboussot/ImpactLoss
